Testimonials

The strongest validation of our work comes from those who’ve experienced it, here’s what our clients have to say.

Pawan Matade

Founder, DeMatade Trading Solutions

AvancePR functions like an addition to our team members. They provide us with full 360-degree integrated communications assistance, and we are quite happy with the professional guidance they have been providing. The team works hard and prepares and executes our PR in a smart manner. They also manage all of the material on our behalf. We aim to keep our relationship with them for the foreseeable future since we respect their role in helping us achieve new heights.

Abhinav Kalia

Founder, ARC Electric

It’s a pleasure working with Ritika and her team on our media campaigns. I am surprised by how energetic the team of these young girls is in delivering unmatched PR services in the industry. We are associated with them for the media relations of Arc Electric and they have delivered as per their commitment and exceeded our expectations. We look forward to a long association!

Major Prashant Veer Singh

Mentor, ARC Electric

Ritika and her agency were hired to shape the marketing campaign of ARC Electric. Team worked diligently to understand our campaign objectives, deliberating various options, finalizing the way forward, and aligning the right team members to complete deliveries in the agreed time frame. Campaign was well received by the desired audience, and we completely achieved our objectives. If any one considering to hire consultants for formulating and delivering on marketing campaigns across multiple channels, then one must look at Ritika and her young energetic team as top option. We wish them good luck in all their endeavors.

Biswajit Mishra

Co-Founder, Hostbooks

Ritika and the dedicated team at AvancePR excel in their passionate and focused approach to client work by using their broad expertise and media links. We are excited to carry on our mutually beneficial partnership, which has been doing great so far. They stand out from the others because they constantly go above and beyond to assist you. Their commitment to understanding objectives, analysing options, and assembling the finest team produced a fantastic campaign that successfully reached our target audience.

Amit Kumar

Co-Founder & CEO, Ramp Global

I became acquainted with Ritika when she joined our team as an intern. We, as a team, greatly admire her discipline, determination, and dedication. These attributes played a crucial role in setting her apart from others and pursuing her aspiration of becoming an entrepreneur. Presently, she is a valued vendor for us, and I am delighted that we engaged her. She continues to exhibit the same commendable qualities and consistently delivers outstanding results.

Swayam Agarwal

Founder, Aarika Innovation

The team at AvancePR is passionate about each of its clients, and it is made up of motivated professionals and experienced workers. They have strong media connections, which helps their clients gain the required attention from the media and the public. We have so far enjoyed a fruitful cooperation and look forward to continuing it. They frequently offer assistance with tasks outside the scope of their job

Meet the Founder

An award-winning entrepreneur recognized by ET 40 Under 40 and ET Women Leaders Awards, Ritika Garg founded Avance PR to redefine how brands communicate and connect.

A communications strategist who began her career at Ogilvy, Ritika brings deep expertise in media relations, corporate communications, and influencer strategy. Under her leadership, Avance PR has grown into one of India’s fastest-emerging strategic communications agencies, trusted by over 100+ brands across technology, education, sustainability, hospitality, finance and other sectors.

Guided by her belief that PR is not just about visibility but credibility, influence, and growth, Ritika continues to lead with innovation, empathy, and a people-first vision.

About Us

Avance PR is a highly regarded and comprehensive public relations agency headquartered in Gurugram, known for crafting powerful narratives that drive visibility, credibility, and influence. We don’t believe in a one-size-fits-all approach — because every brand is different. Our strength lies in understanding each client’s unique story, audience, and ambition, and then designing tailored communication strategies that truly reflect their identity. From strategic media engagement and influencer collaborations to reputation and crisis management, every campaign we craft is built to create meaningful impact and measurable results.

With a proven track record across industries including Technology (B2B & B2C), Education, Consumer Tech, Infrastructure, Retail, Lifestyle, Cybersecurity, FMCG, Real Estate, D2C, B2B2C, Startups, Travel, Astro Tech, Hospitality, Logistics, Healthcare, and Pharma, Avance PR brings together creativity, strategy, and insight to deliver exceptional outcomes. Our team of experienced professionals partners closely with clients to strengthen brand narratives, build trust, and enhance reputation across traditional and digital platforms. At Avance PR, we don’t just tell stories — we shape perceptions, spark conversations, and help brands grow with purpose.

Here’s what makes us different (and effective):
✓
Strategic Positioning

We go beyond press releases. We dig into your story, find your voice, and align it with what the media and your audience actually care about.

✓
High-Impact Media Relations

With a strong network of top journalists and editors, we help you earn visibility in major outlets not ads, but editorial stories that build real trust.

✓
Influencers & Celebrity Connects

We foster media-influencer conversations that amplify reach organically and authentically.

✓
LinkedIn Thought Leadership

Founders who are visible get funded, followed, and featured. We manage CXO LinkedIn profiles to build your personal brand and grow a strong community of investors, collaborators, and future customers. Because your network is your net worth.

✓
Tailored Campaigns for Your Industry

We’ve delivered results for over 100 clients in various sectors like Tech, Fintech, EdTech, D2C, Healthcare, Cybersecurity, Real Estate, EV, Hospitality and more.

Meet Our Founder & CEO
Ritika Garg

Founder & CEO

ET 40 Under 40

ET Women Leaders

Driven by a passion for storytelling and a vision to redefine India’s PR landscape, Ritika Garg founded Avance PR with one clear mission to help brands communicate with clarity, creativity, and credibility.

Under her leadership, Avance PR has evolved from a boutique agency into one of India’s fastest-growing strategic communications firms, trusted by over 100 brands across industries including technology, education, sustainability, hospitality, and finance.

Ritika’s professional journey began at Ogilvy, one of the world’s most respected communication networks, where she honed her expertise in strategic communications, media relations, and brand storytelling. Her experience across diverse sectors has shaped her belief that PR is not just about visibility, it’s about building trust, influence, and business impact.

Her leadership philosophy is rooted in data-driven storytelling and purpose-led branding. Over the years, she has spearheaded campaigns that have generated extensive national media coverage, elevated brand reputation, and created tangible results for startups and corporates alike.

Recognized by The Economic Times 40 Under 40 and ET Women Leaders Awards, Ritika stands among India’s most promising young entrepreneurs known for her ability to blend creative vision with strategic execution.

Today, she continues to champion innovation, authenticity, and people-first leadership, inspiring her team and clients to think bigger, communicate bolder, and build brands that truly make an impact.

"At Avance PR, every brand has a story worth telling and telling it right makes all the difference."

AvancePR

PR For Startups

At Avance PR, we understand that every startup begins with a bold idea but to scale, it needs a strong story. Our Startup PR services are designed to help emerging brands build credibility, attract investors, and gain media visibility in crowded markets. We specialize in positioning founders as thought leaders, crafting compelling launch narratives, and creating momentum that drives both attention and trust. We know startups move fast so we move faster. From pre-launch buzz to post-funding visibility, our agile and insight-driven approach ensures your communication aligns with your business goals, funding stage, and market priorities. At Avance PR, we don't just create news, we build reputations that grow with your company.

Brand Launch PR

We help startups make a powerful first impression with launch campaigns that grab attention. From press releases and founder stories to curated media coverage, we ensure your brand's debut creates impact from day one.

Investor & Funding Communication

Whether it's announcing a seed round or scaling after Series A, we craft funding stories that not only highlight your growth but also build investor confidence. Our messaging focuses on vision, traction, and innovation the three pillars investors look for.

Founder Profiling & Thought Leadership

We position founders as industry voices through interviews, guest articles, LinkedIn storytelling, and panel placements. The goal is to make your leadership visible, relatable, and credible in the eyes of media, partners, and customers.

Product & Innovation Showcasing

We amplify product milestones and innovations through targeted media outreach, influencer seeding, and digital storytelling, ensuring your technology or offering gets noticed by the right audience at the right time.

Crisis & Reputation Management

For startups, reputation is currency. We help you anticipate, navigate, and resolve communication challenges with speed and sensitivity protecting your brand image while maintaining stakeholder trust.
